title: The register the arithmetic rests on
description: No 2026 Mombasa register figure is in hand; the 2022 register is the working base.
notes: The 2022 register (641,913) is the base for every calculation until IEBC publishes the Mombasa row of the 2026 ECVR annex.
Because the register has only grown since 2022, every ballot figure built on it is a floor.

values.label: Register in use for 2026 calculations
values.note: The 2022 register, carried forward: a floor
